subject.title: refactor(plugin-sdk): share channel DM policy setup

question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-dm-policy` become a supported external plugin API, or should this consolidation remain internal to bundled channel implementations?
rationale: The implementation deliberately adds a new documented package export and three public SDK exports; choosing a permanent external contract versus an internal helper is an ownership and compatibility decision, not a mechanical review repair.

options.title: Adopt the SDK subpath
options.body: Accept the factory as the supported channel-policy extension seam after receiving real setup evidence for default and named accounts.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Remove the public export and documentation if the helper is intended only to deduplicate bundled channel code.

recommendation.title: Adopt the SDK subpath
recommendation.body: Accept the factory as the supported channel-policy extension seam after receiving real setup evidence for default and named accounts.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history ties this person to the proposed SDK and channel setup consolidation.
